children: Cavitation Technologies, Inc. reported fiscal 2026 results marked by a sharp decline in revenue to $3K and a widened net loss of ($1.4M) versus ($113K) in the prior year, according to its 10-K filing.
¹ Reported as “Revenue”. ² Reported as “Net loss”. ³ Reported as “Diluted loss per share”.
Revenue collapsed 98.5% year-over-year to $3K as the company shifted away from product sales toward minimal rental and demo income.
Cavitation Technologies assigned vegetable oil refining patents to Desmet, which will manufacture the Nano Reactor®, reducing the Company's reactor sales channel.
The company retained an exclusive royalty-free license for the Nano Reactor® in water, wastewater, oilfield and beverage markets and is pursuing hydro-plasma and non‑thermal plasma technologies.
Management is prioritizing water treatment in the Permian Basin, agricultural disinfection, the Alchemy Beverages joint venture and commercialization of new technologies.
Cash constraints materially impacted operations: R&D (including cold plasma work) was scaled back and the company increased reliance on rentals, demos and expected partner-led commercialization.
